method: printed contents pp. vii-xii (pdf 11-16); Internet Archive scan (Free Press 1955 first edition, Allegheny College library copy) with OCR text. Offset printed+26 = pdf throughout; every chapter and appendix opening ('CHAPTER ...' page) confirmed in the text cache. The book numbers chapters I-VII in Part One and restarts at I-XV in Part Two; the arabic prefixes follow the book's per-part numbering, so '1'..'7' occur in both Parts. The book's intermediate 'Section One/Two/Three/Four' groupings are not given as entries: each Section title sits on the same page as its first chapter (Part One: Sec. 1 pdf 41, Sec. 2 pdf 69; Part Two: Sec. 1 pdf 163, Sec. 2 pdf 188, Sec. 3 pdf 245, Sec. 4 'Technical Appendices and Commentaries on the Research' pdf 361 = Appendix A). No chapter exceeds 35 pages (longest: Part One VI, pdf 108-141, 34 pp.), so unnumbered sub-headings are omitted. pdf 1-10 cover/library/title pages, pdf 25-26 half-title, pdf 427-435 endpapers/library slip, pdf 436 back-cover blurb.
